selection_policy: Visually screen all saved detection crops; select varied failure/occlusion families; omit repetitive frames.

split_policy.scope: Batch 6 only; previous annotations/splits preserved byte-for-byte.
split_policy.limitation: Curated hard-case validation, not unbiased live precision/recall. Future frames from a reserved run must retain its split; augmentations inherit source split.
